en.title: Thermal Camera for Drones – OEM Module | DUNADRON
en.desc: OEM thermal camera for drones: 960 × 768 processed video at 50 Hz, F1.0 optics, HD digital link + USB UVC, under 1.5 W. For SAR, security and inspection.
en.intro: Thermal imaging for drone manufacturers and integrators. The ThermaView 960 delivers 960 × 768 processed thermal video at 50 Hz through 9.1 mm F1.0 optics, streams simultaneously over the HD digital video link and USB UVC, and typically draws under 1.5 W. It is supplied as an OEM module or under your own brand, with evaluation kits and integration support for search and rescue, security, industrial inspection and firefighting drones.

es.intro: Imagen térmica para fabricantes e integradores de drones. La ThermaView 960 ofrece vídeo térmico procesado de 960 × 768 a 50 Hz con óptica de 9,1 mm F1.0, transmite a la vez por el enlace de vídeo digital HD y por USB UVC, y su consumo típico es inferior a 1,5 W. Se suministra como módulo OEM o con tu propia marca, con kits de evaluación y soporte de integración para drones de rescate, seguridad, inspección industrial y bomberos.

The AeroLink GT8 Kit offers 22 ms average latency, 8 channels and 1080p onboard recording, so OEMs can integrate a proven video link instead of sourcing parts separately.

Choose the AeroLink GT8 VTX for 22 ms average latency and onboard recording, or the AeroLink PX for live 1080p at 60 fps on professional inspection and security aircraft. Both are available for OEM integration with engineering support.

El AeroLink GT8 VTX ofrece 22 ms de latencia media y grabación a bordo; el AeroLink PX transmite imagen en directo 1080p a 60 fps para drones profesionales de inspección y seguridad.
